summary: Add two real-Store controls for production Installer journal pruning with two fixture consumers.

replay.detail: No startup replay, backfill or production mechanism is added.

schema.detail: Private controls share existing fixture namespace tables; no production DDL, index or migration change.

rules.detail: The unchanged library alone selects the journal cutoff. Admission, ordering, retention and operator policy are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Tests discriminate slow-root and active-job pins, explicit cancellation and stale-page refusal. All images stay retained. Two-consumer image reclamation, crash/reopen, rollback/refused-COMMIT and whole-prune work remain unverified; no performance or production-readiness claim.

recovery.detail: No new writer callback, retry, automatic restart, reader repair or transaction cleanup policy.
